name: Herzegovina Day Tour
tagline: A full day from Mostar to Blagaj, Počitelj and the Kravice Waterfalls, with a local guide at every stop.
level: Moderate: uneven paths and steps at some stops
meetingPoint: Mostar, pickup point agreed with you
availability: By prior arrangement; route adjusted to the season
description: Spend a day outside Mostar visiting places that show the variety of Herzegovina: the Buna River spring at Blagaj, historic Počitelj and the Kravice Waterfalls. The route can be adjusted to the season, opening hours, your interests and the time you have. A local guide gives context at each stop and keeps the day at a comfortable pace.

itinerary.text: Blagaj and the Buna River spring, with time to see the Dervish Tekke area if included.
Počitelj, the historic hillside village and open-air heritage site.
Kravice Waterfalls, with time to walk around the falls.
Mogorjelo, when the route and timing allow.
Fortica Skywalk, subject to timing and your preference.

notIncluded: Meals and drinks, unless the written quote says otherwise
practical: Transport and entrance fees are itemised in your written offer.
Bring comfortable shoes; in summer, swimwear if you plan to spend time at Kravice.
notes: Decide the standard route: the old document lists Blagaj, Počitelj, Mogorjelo and Kravice with Fortica optional, which may make a long day.
Confirm transport inclusion, ticket prices, lunch arrangements and the current per-person or private-group price. Old reference: €50 per person guiding, Kravice €10 per person.
The swimwear line is our suggestion: confirm swimming rules at Kravice or remove.
seoTitle: Herzegovina Day Tour from Mostar: Blagaj, Počitelj, Kravice
seoDescription: Full-day tour from Mostar with a licensed local guide: Blagaj and the Buna spring, Počitelj and the Kravice Waterfalls. Route adjusted to the season.
